line: A graphics card is unscrewed on a workbench, its chip dived into layer by layer, and behind it stand a machine the size of a bus and twenty years of software.

stylist.notes: Our own style (not from lemo-opuscar). Sounds: material foley with a visible cause only; no swooshes or sweeps. Complex props are modelled in Blender (kit blender/mesh_export.py) when available; one subject per shot, filling a third of the frame.

camera.serves: a chip, a die, a seal

camera.move: Match-zoom through a part into a new scale
camera.expresses: the next level of the answer
camera.serves: die to layers to wires; machine to droplet

camera.move: Slow lateral track along a row of objects
Pull back up to the whole bench

transitions: Transitions are camera moves: a push into a part that becomes the next scene, a pan along the bench to the next prop.
No cuts to black, no wipes, no split screens.
labels: Captions in the scene: heavy black grotesque, lower-case, 60-90 px, a thin paper-coloured halo, in the air above the object; at most four words, only numbers the voice says.
Tags: paper tag with ink border on a leader whose dot lands on the part; name in the heavy face, one spec line in mono, units always written.
motion: 24 fps; camera and mechanical motion on ones; captions pop over 3 frames.
Separation: top layer first, 0.15-0.25 s apart, ease-in-out cubic, short settle; screws quarter-turn then lift in order.
Apart is never ruler-straight: each layer drifts 1-4 cm and tilts 2-6 degrees; repeated parts (fans) spread with different heights and tilts.
Held apart, layers float slightly with offset phases and their shadows follow; closing bottom first, no bounce.
Props enter on the word that names them, by motion (alternate sides), never by appearing; nothing pops, scale never changes while visible.

native_moves.name: Screw out, lift off
native_moves.does: Screws turn a quarter, rise in order, the cover lifts.

native_moves.name: The floating stack
native_moves.does: All layers held apart above the mat, each with its hatched shadow.

native_moves.name: Into the part
native_moves.does: The camera pushes into a part until it becomes a new scene at a new scale.
native_moves.fits: die, layers, wires; a lens; a cell

native_moves.name: Desk-toy comparison
native_moves.does: Toy-sized props set down beside the product with a counter tag each.

native_moves.name: Peel
native_moves.does: Layers of one part lift off one by one like sheets.

native_moves.name: Back on the bench
native_moves.does: The film ends on the bench with the one thing to remember as a caption.

native_moves.name: Count apart
native_moves.does: When the voice gives a part count, that object comes apart into its own parts on the word.
native_moves.fits: hundreds vs thousands vs millions of parts

native_moves.name: Into the eyepiece
native_moves.does: The part is set under a microscope, the camera travels into the eyepiece and the plan draws itself as a diagram.

native_moves.name: Area sweep
native_moves.does: A spoken area sweeps across the part and fills it, with the number riding the edge.

score.note: tuned mallets and glass, a round bass, no drums
